name: amigurumi.ai
promise: Watch a toy get crocheted from one strand of yarn in 30 seconds, then get the free pattern.
rules: The knit on screen is the real pattern: every round and stitch count shown comes from the toy's amikit spec.
The hook names the toy in the first 0.5 s; text on screen is short, one idea per caption.
The 'real life' photo is the finished toy of the same spec, never a different toy.
Every number on screen (pieces, stitches, cm, hours, metres) comes from the spec or the pattern page.
The CTA promises only what amigurumi.ai gives for this toy (free pattern, 3D model, PDF).
Generated images and synthetic music are disclosed in the description and in the upload flag.

type_rules: captions: Unbounded Bold in cream with a navy stroke and a soft navy shadow, words pop in one by one
yellow for the toy's name, 'Done!', 'real life' and the button text; pink for the fastest speed chips
chips (round text, stitch counter, stats): Onest on a cream pill; the CTA button is navy with yellow text

voice.base_direction: No narration: music and stitch ticks only.
